description: Daily climate records (max/min/mean temperature °C, total precipitation mm, snow on ground cm) for an Environment Canada station over a date range. Use a 7-digit climate identifier, e.g. "6158355" (TORONTO CITY) or "1108395" (VANCOUVER INTL A). Station IDs come from the climate-stations collection. Keyless, official ECCC data.

end_date.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-05-07". Max 50 days returned.

name: climate_daily
